units.source_text: 彩车一般是在头一天组装好。

en.t: The festival floats are usually assembled the day before.

units.source_text: 七月十日的“洗神轿”可能是典礼的序幕。

en.t: The "washing of the mikoshi" on July 10 may be the prelude to the ceremony.

units.source_text: 在鸭川的四条大桥上洗神轿，虽说是洗，实际上只是由神官把杨桐蘸蘸水，然后往神轿上洒洒罢了。

en.t: The mikoshi is washed on Shijo Bridge over the Kamo River, but though it is called washing, in reality the priests simply dip a branch of cleyera in water and sprinkle it over the mikoshi.
